# Dastak 90807 (Dastak Online Document Facilitation)

> Independent document facilitation service run by Muhammad Usman, a registered facilitator under the Government of Punjab's Maryam Ki Dastak program (Facilitator Code 90807). This is not a government website or department. Fees are generated by the official Dastak system. Always verify details on the official portal (https://dastak.punjab.gov.pk) or helpline 1202.

## Key pages
- [Services](https://dastak90807.com/en/services/): driving license, police, vehicle, civil document and guidance services in Punjab
- [How it works](https://dastak90807.com/en/how-it-works/): booking in the official Dastak app (Doorstep Service, Facilitator Code 90807), WhatsApp or phone
- [About and how to verify me](https://dastak90807.com/en/about/)
- [FAQs](https://dastak90807.com/en/faqs/)
- [Contact](https://dastak90807.com/en/contact/): WhatsApp and phone 0345-5583530
- [Disclaimer](https://dastak90807.com/en/disclaimer/)

## Area
Doorstep help in Gujar Khan, Kallar Syedan and surrounding areas, where available. Inquiries accepted 24 hours.

## Citizen resources
- [Official links](https://dastak90807.com/en/citizen-tools/): Punjab verification, tracking and payment portals
- [Fee calculators](https://dastak90807.com/en/calculators/): supplied driving licence, car and motorcycle estimates
- [Downloads](https://dastak90807.com/en/downloads/): official form resources
